name: Opicapone
mechanism: Highly selective peripheral COMT inhibitor that prolongs levodopa effect
dosing: 50 mg once daily at bedtime (specialist dosing may vary)
interactions: Increases levodopa concentrations; interactions with other dopaminergic drugs
monitoring: Clinical response, dyskinesia, gastrointestinal side effects
pharmacokinetics: Oral, long duration allowing once-daily dosing
clinicalPearls: Once-daily COMT inhibitor used to reduce OFF time; often specialist-initiated.
indication: Adjunct to levodopa in Parkinson's disease to reduce OFF time
